That does not prove immateriality, and I am not claiming that. It does matter to how the record should be characterized: targeted limitation, live disclosure, monitored deployment basis. 5. That means the business-cost question is not whether to ignore the gap; it is whether the uncertainty is better handled through an explicit caveat and live disclosure versus a higher-friction escalation path. On this record, the lower-cost defensible move is to avoid escalation while refusing any clean-certification wording.
output.claims_about_policy: Policy cuts in two directions here.
